newsitem.title: THAILAND: Eleven killed in Thailand road crash.
newsitem.headline: Eleven killed in Thailand road crash.

text.p: A pre-dawn road accident north of Bangkok killed 11 people and injured 15, police said on Tuesday.
They said a Bangkok-bound bus crashed into a car in Manorom district in Chainart province, about 190 km (120 miles) from the capital.
The bus overturned, killing 11 passengers, police said. The car's driver and passenger were listed in critical condition.
